description: Disable a Monitor, stopping its scheduled Cycles and the Fuel or plan usage they bring; disabling closes the Monitor's open Incidents. Idempotent. Disabling, and enabling again with enable_monitor, both need the "Launch" access level; below that level a call is refused, and the user disables or re-enables the Monitor in the Dashboard at the link get_monitor returns.
name: disable_monitor
title: Disable Monitor
